_note:
Slots for [brg_home-hero]. Declared beside the fragment so a slot and its {token} ship in one commit. Generated into website/acf/ by `python3 kit/build-acf.py`; never hand-edit an acf.json. Slot names are underscore-only. `text`/`textarea`/`lines` defaults are esc_html'd on fill, so write literal characters — a literal `&` and a literal `—`, never `&` or `—`.\n\nTHE

IS NOW WIRED, as type `lines`. It was declined on 2026-08-13 for one reason only: the headline carries a structural break — `We're in the business / of making your day great.` — and no slot type could carry it. text/textarea escaped it into a visible <br> and html returned

-wrapped content nested inside the

. `lines` escapes first and turns the editor's newline into
after, which expresses the break without the field accepting markup. The constraint was real; it stopped being a constraint when the type existed.

heading.label: Headline
heading.doc: The hero headline. PRESS RETURN where you want the line to break — it breaks exactly there. Two lines is the design; three starts eating the fold on a phone.
heading.default:
We're in the business
of making your day great.

sub.label: Sub copy
sub.doc: Sits under the marker underline, capped at 52ch. Plain text; markup is escaped. Write `&` and `—` as literal characters. PRESS RETURN to force a line break exactly where you want one.
sub.default: From a classic Board & Brew sandwich to a slice at Odie's — we're here for the moments that matter.

tagline.label: Yellow tagline
tagline.doc: The short line beneath the sub, in the display face. White, not yellow, per the comp. ~40 characters.
tagline.default: Good food. Real people. Rad experience.

uline_variant.label: Underline animation
uline_variant.doc: How the hand-drawn underline reveals. `u3` (default) filled brush + ~5deg angled wipe — keeps the taper. `wipe` straight-edged reveal, the conservative fallback with no skewed edge to overhang. `u1` scaleX bar, the lab's baseline, kept so the taper argument can be re-checked live. Unknown or blank renders the mark STATIC and visible, never hidden. u2/u4 (dasharray draws) need the artwork inline as SVG and are not available on an . Catalog: website/lab/README.md.

bg_photo.label: Background photo
bg_photo.doc: The full-bleed hero collage behind the logo and headline. Dark imagery works best — the headline and sub copy sit on top in white. Landscape, at least 1600px wide. Leave empty to keep the current picture.

bg_photo_tone.label: Background photo — color
bg_photo_tone.doc: Color is the default. Switch this photo to black and white when you want it that way on purpose — the photography on this site was only ever gray because the placeholder images were. Affects this photo alone.

bg_photo_px.label: Background photo — movement
bg_photo_px.doc: How far this photo drifts inside its frame as you scroll. The photo is laid out taller than its frame and slides within it, so an edge never appears and it is never zoomed.

bg_photo_px_dir.label: Background photo — movement direction
bg_photo_px_dir.doc: Which way this photo travels as the page scrolls. Neighboring photos set in opposite directions are what reads as depth.

bg_photo_float.label: Background photo — frame drift
bg_photo_float.doc: Moves the whole frame across the section, on top of the movement inside it. Leave off for a photo that fills its section edge to edge — there is nothing behind it to reveal.

bg_photo_float_dir.label: Background photo — drift direction
bg_photo_float_dir.doc: Which way this frame drifts. Set a large and a small photo in opposite directions.

video_id.label: Background video (optional)
video_id.doc: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, or just the ID. Leave blank and the photo above is used. The video plays silently on a loop with no controls, and the photo shows while it loads, if the video is blocked, or for visitors who have switched off animation.

video_source.label: Video from
video_source.doc: Which service the link is from. Only matters when a video is set.

overlay_color.label: Overlay color
overlay_color.doc: A flat color laid over the background photo to keep the headline readable. This does nothing when no photo is set. Choose None to turn the overlay off entirely.

overlay_strength.label: Overlay strength
overlay_strength.doc: How much of the overlay color shows through. Only has an effect once an overlay color is chosen above. 45% is the usual setting for white type over a photo — go higher if the headline still fights the picture, lower if the photo is already dark.
